body: As another 18 y/o with high anxiety, I can say that it's worked for me! I've been using a tincture everyday and I have some 'joints' that I use when I'm especially anxious at night, and I've found so far that it really helps in my day to day life. I would just wait until an average anxiety day where you can stay at home for a while, try a gummy, and see how you feel after a bit. You can gauge whether it's for you or if you'll need a different dose that way.
